name: marketplace-api
description: Marketplace API — OpenAPI contract (HW #9) + config/secrets (HW #11) + TypeORM data layer (HW #13) + concurrency: race-free checkout, SKIP LOCKED workers, retry (HW #14) + PgBouncer + backup/restore drill (HW #15) + testcontainers/E2E/Pact contract trust ladder (HW #16) + realtime WebSocket/SSE (HW #18) + async events over RabbitMQ (HW #19) + transactional outbox, relay, idempotent consumer (HW #22) + Redis: cache-aside/single-flight, sessions, shared rate limit, BullMQ queue (HW #23) + auth: ES256 access tokens, refresh rotation with reuse detection, logout denylist, RBAC + ownership (HW #24) + files: presigned direct-to-storage uploads, resumable multipart, private bucket behind a caching edge, hashed immutable assets (HW #26) + Kubernetes: distroless image, kind cluster via Pulumi, zero-failure rolling update, PDB, HPA (HW #28)
